name: 32836 · Orlando, FL
findings: ZIP 32836 (Orlando) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32836 (Orlando) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32836 (Orlando) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 58 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
